title: $20 Amazon Promo Credit on $200 Apple eGift Card Spend @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: $20 Amazon Promo Credit on $200 Apple eGift Card Spend @ Amazon AU

[heraldus] can i stack and use this to buy mac book pro?
[ChipsChicky] yes, if you mean that you are planning to buy from Apple Store.
[coxymla] You only get the credit on one $200 Apple GC.
Better to wait for 10% supermarket rewards if you want to stack lots of GC.
[1ozbargainer] does this stack with amex spend $50 get $5 back?
[c9] Patiently waiting for Qantas marketplace
[Kabal] Can i pay for it using amazon gift card credit?
[TeamTerry] Can I use this to take advantage of the $300 a year ChatGPT offer? - https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/979335
I assume I purchase the Apple Gift Cards for $300 and get a $30 credit for Amazon?
Or is it simply a $20 Amazon credit only
[timliu1996] In order to qualify for the $20 promotional credit (which can be used on future eligible orders),
So it’s Amazon credit, not $20 Apple gift card
[sphinxy] The GCDB link suggests you should be able to.
[readeral] T&C’s say:
“The promotional credit can only be redeemed once per customer on eligible items.” - which I think actually refers to using one credit on your future Amazon purchase, however… implicitly I think it means you can only use one credit. the general vibe of the terms keeps reiterating a singular promotional credit applied to your account.
Also, the credit has some pretty tight constraints:
This promotional credit entitles you to $20 off your future purchase of “eligible items” shipped and sold by Amazon AU and will be automatically applied to your next purchase of eligible item(s). “Eligible items” excludes products sold by third party sellers including Amazon US (Amazon Global Store) and Amazon UK even if fulfilled by Amazon, digital purchases such as e-books, products that are not in new condition such as renewed products, subscriptions such as Prime Video and Audible, any gift cards and postage or delivery rates. Amazon AU’s standard delivery rates and policies apply to any purchase made pursuant to this Offer.
[sphinxy] Yes, a comment in that thread did mention that the promo amount probably can't be stacked (in the future purchase)
[iJeff] Can I use the $20 Amazon credit to buy another $20 Apple gift card?
[xenoic] No you can’t. I’ve tried in previous promos like this
[xmagic] Too stupid to make a purchase the moment I read this, only to realise the promo starts in a few days.
Then Amazon decided to ban my account. After the account is reinstated, the order shows as cancelled. What a silver lining :P
